newsitem.title: USA: Centocor says cA2 test results positive.
newsitem.headline: Centocor says cA2 test results positive.

text.p: Centocor Inc said Friday that data from a pivotal trial in patients with Crohn's disease showed treatment with the cA2 monoclonal antibody produced a statistically significant positive result in the trial's primary endpoint, with closure of at least 50 percent of open fistulae.

The company said the data demonstrated that cA2 has utility in treating a severe complication in Crohn's disease patients, and that it is looking forward to working with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and European health authorities in bringing this product to the market as quickly as possible.
The company said full results of this study will be released at an appropriate medical forum in 1997.
Centocor is a biotechnology company whose primary technological focus is on monoclonal antibodies and DNA-based products.
